get.description: A game's cover, by the name its game records (F10-S21, added).

post.description: Write the profile's marker to the device again, as a job on the device (F10-S24).

get.description: What the device holds that the library does not, from what was recorded.

post.description: Pull one item and place it in the store, never overwriting, as a job.
Read the device's games into its inventory, read-only, as a job (F10-S24, added).

get.description: Readiness from the last survey. Reads nothing from the device.

post.description:
Remove one stray item under the staging root, as a job. The folder is
checked before the job starts.
List the device's staging and install folders, read-only, as a job.
Stage a system's files to its staging folder, as a job.
Remove a system's staged files, as a job.

get.description:
A zip for a bug report: the system, the settings with every secret left
out, the recent jobs and the logs, each searched for every secret (F15-S3).
Built in memory; nothing is written.

post.description: Pin one game to a metadata entry by id, slug or link, as a job.
Fill missing box art from the libretro thumbnails, as a job.
Propose franchise tags from the rules, as a job. Decisions are never overwritten.
Match every game still pending against the metadata service, as a job.
Bring the library to what the store holds, as a job.

get.description: What the action would do now. Changes nothing.

post.description: Run the action as a job. A destructive one must name its dry run's count.

get.description: What the device held when it was last read (F10-S22, added).
The device's last twenty runs, newest first (F10-S22, added).

post.description:
Validate every key, store them, delete a key sent as null. A rejection
names its field; a secret is never echoed back.

get.description:
The drives with no `path`, else that folder's subfolders, and its files of
the extensions in `files`. Names only, nothing read inside a file, nothing written.

post.description: Never an error: a notification that cannot be shown is `delivered: false`.

get.description:
The data folder by part, every subfolder counted, with what maintenance
would reclaim from each (F15-S2).
Every requirement with the store's copy only, for when no device is chosen.
